game_concept: A survival strategy set in Coastal Port – Smugglers' Bay, a hidden smugglers' bay: the dock cartographer must handle jellyfish swarms while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Rule Duel: Write rules that beat the AI's chosen move in a best-of-rounds duel.
theme: Coastal Port – Smugglers' Bay: a hidden smugglers' bay
core_gameplay_loop: In Smugglers' Bay, repeat each round: Write rules that beat the AI's chosen move in a best-of-rounds duel. Each round, jellyfish swarms strike the cargo hold, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the duel_hp value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the cargo hold from jellyfish swarms in Smugglers' Bay: keep the duel_hp meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 30-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: duel_hp drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 30-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 1 (intro tier): Rule Duel
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Rule Duel' (Week 3 slot 11), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Smugglers' Bay'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how duel_hp changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against jellyfish swarms in Smugglers' Bay.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 30 seconds while duel_hp > 0.
